news.title: Le marché des Enfants-Rouges, à Paris, "ravagé" par un incendie
news.summary: Un feu a "ravagé" le marché des Enfants-Rouges, situé au cœur de la capitale, a annoncé la mairie de Paris Centre tôt lundi matin. Il s'agit du plus vieux marché couvert de Paris
news.credit_fr: D'après l'actualité du 12 octobre : Le marché des Enfants-Rouges, à Paris, "ravagé" par un incendie (France 24)
news.mechanic_fr: Un incendie important déclenche des contrôles et des fermetures; les achats immobiliers du quartier deviennent urgents.
news.entry_fr: La nouvelle arrive via Romy: elle dit que le marché a brûlé et que plusieurs cafés ont été achetés.

plate.brief: Place: Le Mistral interior today, Objects: a small handheld camera on the counter, a wet umbrella leaned by the door, Light: grey daylight through rain-streaked windows, Weather: steady rain, puddles on the street

pick.mechanic_fr: Un incendie majeur au marché voisin déclenche des fermetures administratives et des contrôles de sécurité obligatoires pour tous les établissements du quartier, y compris Le Mistral.
pick.why: It forces immediate inspections/closures that could determine whether Le Mistral reopens and what happens to the flat above.

draft.premise_fr: Romy a la caméra au zinc. Elle interviewe Margaux sur Solvel puis elle se tourne vers toi: «C'est toi, l'héritage ? Qui es-tu, et que penses-tu de Solvel ?» Il pleut dehors; la nouvelle d'un grand incendie au marché voisin met tout le quartier en alerte.
draft.setup_native: Romy asks who you are and what you think of Solvel; tell her briefly.
draft.objective_native: Tell Romy who you are and say briefly what you think of Solvel and why.
draft.objective_semantics: Learner must identify themself (one short phrase) and give a simple opinion about Solvel with a reason (one clause): two short acts, suitable for A2.
draft.causal_reason: Romy's investigation into Solvel brings a reporter's question to the café; the recent market fire makes local property sales urgent and the learner's opinion matters to her story.

chapter.dramatic_question: Vas-tu dire ta vérité à Romy, et quelle sera sa suite ?
possible_developments: Tu dis que tu veux garder l'appartement et Romy te promet de t'écouter.
Tu dis que tu hésites et Romy propose d'enquêter doucement.
Tu blâme Solvel et Romy te demande une source.
Tu refuses et Romy respecte ton silence, mais garde la caméra éteinte.

panels.narration_fr: La pluie claque contre la vitre. Romy a la caméra allumée.

dialogue.text_fr: Le marché a brûlé ce matin. Trois cafés ont été achetés ici cette année.
dialogue.text_native: The market burned this morning. Three cafés here were bought this year.

panels.visual_direction: Wide shot from behind the zinc: Romy with her small camera, Margaux drying a glass, Gus in the booth with a napkin, Marin carrying a thermos. Rain on the window.
panels.alt_native: Interior of Le Mistral: Romy with a camera, Margaux at the counter, rain outside.

panels.narration_fr: Gus fait le spectacle, Marin sourit, Lila note quelque chose.

dialogue.text_fr: Règle numéro un : on protège le zinc.
dialogue.text_native: Rule number one: we protect the counter.

dialogue.text_fr: C'est pas pire, Romy. Tu as une source ?
dialogue.text_native: Not bad, Romy. Do you have a source?

panels.visual_direction: Medium close: Gus leans on the napkin, theatrical; Marin sets down the thermos, smiling; Lila whispers to Marin off-panel.
panels.alt_native: Gus speaks dramatically at the booth while Marin listens and Lila writes.

panels.narration_fr: Romy éteint l'enregistreur puis te regarde.

dialogue.text_fr: C'est toi, l'héritage ? Qui es-tu, et que penses-tu de Solvel ?
dialogue.text_native: Are you the heir? Who are you, and what do you think of Solvel?

panels.visual_direction: Close shot on Romy as she turns the camera off and faces the learner across the zinc; Margaux watches quietly.
panels.alt_native: Romy looks directly at the learner across the counter, camera in hand.

panels.narration_fr: Tout le monde se tait un instant. La question attend.
panels.visual_direction: Two-shot: the learner at the bar (off-panel viewpoint), Romy patient; Gus and Marin glance at each other, waiting. A panel with no other dialogue.
panels.alt_native: Everyone waits in silence at the café as Romy waits for an answer.

dialogue.text_fr: Je veux juste comprendre, selon toi, s'il faut alerter les voisins.
dialogue.text_native: I just want to understand, according to you, whether we should alert the neighbours.

panels.visual_direction: Medium: Romy leans forward, gentle; the rain makes a steady rhythm outside the neon sign.
panels.alt_native: Romy asks the learner gently if they think the neighbours should be warned.

draft.opening_line_fr: C'est toi, l'héritage ? Qui es-tu, et que penses-tu de Solvel ?
draft.suggested_response_fr: Je suis l'héritier et je pense que Solvel achète trop vite, parce que ça change le quartier.
draft.hint_native: Say who you are (one short phrase) and give a brief opinion with one reason. For example: 'I am the heir, and I think Solvel buys too fast because it changes the neighbourhood.'
draft.translation_native: Romy asks who you are and what you think of Solvel. Tell her your identity and a short opinion with a reason.

lexicon.gloss_native: inheritance, what is left by someone who died
a person who provides information to a reporter

season_checklist.change_before: You are a stranger here, the reporter is asking questions.
season_checklist.change_after: Romy knows who you are and has your view on Solvel.
season_checklist.hook_fr: À suivre… Romy garde la caméra éteinte, mais pas ses notes.
season_checklist.complication: The market fire forces inspections, so Solvel's purchases become urgent for authorities and buyers tomorrow.

refusals.hint: Romy says «tu» to the learner in this season, but here says «vous»: «C'est vous, l'héritage ? Qui êtes-vous, et que pensez-vous de Solvel ?». Rewrite Romy's lines with tu (tu, toi, ton, ta): from someone who knows the learner, a «vous» reads as a stranger's. Keep the narration's address the same as theirs.
